meta.parties: Elpi Nona v. Punchi Singho Et Al

rules.statement: A co-owner has the right to build and live on common land, provided that such use is reasonable and proportionate to their share of ownership.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would not say that in no case can a co-owner build without expressed consent ", said Moncreiff J. " Building might be a natural and necessary act I conceive that consent of the co-owners would not be required for an act sanctioned by the practice of the co-owners, or which is a natural or necessary element of their co-ownership."
